# SmartLink NG

> SmartLink NG is Nigeria's premier all-in-one digital services, identity verification, and automated utility vending platform. We empower individuals and businesses with sub-second NIN verification, BVN validation, CAC business name registration, automated VTU airtime & data bundles, electricity meter token generation, and enterprise developer APIs.

## Core Platforms & Services

- [Explore Services](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/explore): Comprehensive catalog of identity verifications, business filings, and bill payments.
- [Identity Verification](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/nin): Instant NIN verification, slip downloading, and BVN validation.
- [Bills & Utilities](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/bills): Automated electricity meter tokens (IKEDC, EKEDC, AEDC, IBEDC), cable TV subscriptions, and cheap SME data.
- [Airtime Topup](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/airtime): VTU airtime recharges across MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile with instant cashbacks.

## Developer & API Resources

- [API Documentation](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/api-docs): Full REST API reference for integrating NIN, BVN, VTU airtime, data, and utility payments into third-party applications.
- [API Status & Health](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/api/health): Real-time gateway status and operational metrics.

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/privacy): User data privacy, encryption, and NIMC compliance standards.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://smartlinkng.com.ng/terms): Service delivery terms, refund policies, and transaction irreversibility guidelines.
